title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Presentation of Nominees)
(1) Deleted on May 29, 2018.
(2) The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court shall present to the Recommendation Committee persons nominated under Article 6 who have no obvious ground for disqualification. [Amended on May 29, 2018.]
(3) When presenting the nominees under paragraph (2), the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court shall submit their principal personal information, including education, career history, property, and military service. [Amended on May 29, 2018.]
